description: This file is a PHP source code defining the TaxRate controller class within the Opencart admin namespace. It manages event-driven actions related to tax rates, such as adding, editing, and deleting tax rates, and interacts with models to enqueue tasks based on these events.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Controller class handling tax rate related events in the admin area, including adding, editing, and deleting tax rates, and scheduling associated tasks.

methods.name: addTaxRate
methods.description: Handles the event for adding a new tax rate; schedules a task with details including geo zone ID.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Handles the event for editing an existing tax rate, may schedule additional tasks if geo zone ID changes.

methods.name: deleteTaxRate
methods.description: Handles the event for deleting a tax rate; schedules a task to perform related cleanup actions.
